instruction.text: What situations usually feel comfortable or uncomfortable? Drag the situations to the correct group.

feedback.finish: We often feel uncomfortable in unfamiliar situations, where we are uncertain about what to do. Pressure is also something that usually makes us feel uncomfortable.

atoms.b: being with people you don’t know

instruction.text: What is pressure? Fill in the gaps.

feedback.finish: However, there are still some things that you should do even if you don’t want to. Things like going to school or eating your greens are very important!

atoms.b: Pressure is when someone is trying to ((++force help)) you to do something. This can be in the form of not taking no for an answer, or making you feel ((++bad happy)) if you don’t want to go along with it.
You always have the right to say no. ((++No_one Everyone)) should ever make you do something you don’t want to do.

instruction.text: Read each person’s situation and decide if they are being put under pressure or not.

atoms.a: Harry wants to buy a new book, but he doesn’t know which one. His friend recommends a few of his favourite books to Harry.

feedback.end: Correct! Harry’s friend is only giving suggestions to help him, and not trying to force him to choose something in particular.

atoms.a: Isabella hasn’t finished eating lunch yet, but her friends are already done. They tell her they’re going to leave without her if she takes too long.

feedback.end: Correct! Isabella’s friends are trying to make her eat faster by threatening to leave her alone if she doesn’t.

atoms.a: Abigail is scared to go on rollercoasters. Her friends tell her that she’s being a baby if she can’t even give it a go.

feedback.end: Correct! Abigail’s friends are trying to make her do something she’s nervous about by insulting her.

atoms.a: Owen’s friends like picking on their weaker classmates. He feels uncomfortable about their behaviour, but he’s afraid they’ll laugh at him if he tells them to stop.

feedback.end: Correct! Owen feels uncertain about what to do. He disagrees with his friends’ actions but also doesn’t want them to turn against him.

instruction.text: When you’re under pressure in an uncomfortable situation, you should remind yourself of this. Fill in the gaps.

feedback.finish: If anyone keeps trying to put pressure on you, especially when you say no, you should talk to a trusted adult about it.

atoms.sound: I am always allowed to say no when people try to make me do things I’m not comfortable with.
